description: Describe the data you can query: what it holds and how it is organised.
name: describe_data

description: Run one read-only SQL query (PostgreSQL 18) and get up to 200 rows. A single SELECT or WITH statement; the statement timeout is 10 s.
name: run_sql

description: Submit the final answer, once. kind 'values' with the complete set of identifiers the question asks for (product NDCs, package NDCs, UNIIs, report ids, recall numbers, RxCUIs, firm names), 'number' for a count or a measure, or 'none' when the entity the question names does not exist or nothing satisfies the question; evidence lists the numbers of the tool calls that produced it.

input_schema.description: The final answer, the same for every arm.

evidence.description: Numbers of the tool calls that produced the answer.
evidence.title: Evidence

number.description: kind number: the count or measure.
number.title: Number

values.description: kind values: the complete set of identifiers (or names, where the question asks for names).
values.title: Values

input_schema.title: H1Answer

name: submit_answer
